Type: white six-drawer dresser
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a mirror and lamps; bedroom, guest room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: white painted wood and fiberboard, polished metal bow handles
Colors: bright white, silver handles
Shape: wide low dresser with two columns of three drawers, inset panel fronts, curved metal handles, softly molded top edge, short turned tapered feet, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, fresh, graceful, calm
Goes with: pale grey or blush walls, white bedding, silver or crystal accents; classic, traditional or romantic bedrooms

product.name: TYSSEDAL
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
